import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np


def task_func(data_dict):
    df = pd.DataFrame(data_dict)

    if df.shape[1] == 0:
        return []

    n_cols = df.shape[1]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(n_cols, 1, figsize=(8, max(3, 3 * n_cols)))
    if n_cols == 1:
        axes = [axes]
    else:
        axes = list(np.ravel(axes))

    for ax, col in zip(axes, df.columns):
        series = df[col].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()

        if series.empty:
            ax.set_title(str(col))
            ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No data", ha="center", va="center", transform=ax.transAxes)
            ax.set_xticks([])
            ax.set_yticks([])
            continue

        numeric = pd.to_numeric(series, errors="coerce")
        is_numeric = numeric.notna().all()

        if is_numeric:
            values = numeric.to_numpy(dtype=float)
            unique_count = pd.Series(values).nunique(dropna=True)

            if unique_count <= 1:
                bins = 1
                non_uniform = True
            else:
                bins = min(10, max(1, int(np.sqrt(len(values)))))
                counts, _ = np.histogram(values, bins=bins)
                expected = len(values) / bins if bins else 0
                non_uniform = (
                    expected > 0
                    and (
                        np.any(counts == 0)
                        or (np.max(np.abs(counts - expected)) / expected > 0.5)
                    )
                )

            ax.hist(values, bins=bins, edgecolor="black", alpha=0.75)
            ax.set_xlabel(str(col))
            ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
            ax.set_title(str(col))

            if non_uniform:
                print(f"Column '{col}' appears to have a non-uniform distribution.")

        else:
            codes, uniques = pd.factorize(series.astype(object), sort=True)
            counts = np.bincount(codes)

            ax.hist(codes, bins=max(len(uniques), 1), edgecolor="black", alpha=0.75)
            ax.set_xlabel(str(col))
            ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
            ax.set_title(str(col))
            ax.set_xticks(range(len(uniques)))
            ax.set_xticklabels([str(u) for u in uniques], rotation=45, ha="right")

            non_uniform = len(counts) <= 1 or (
                counts.mean() > 0 and (np.max(np.abs(counts - counts.mean())) / counts.mean() > 0.5)
            )

            if non_uniform:
                print(f"Column '{col}' appears to have a non-uniform distribution.")

    fig.tight_layout()
    return axes
